decisions.safety_protocol: Temporary hold on bedside stock of the intravenous anticoagulant, with supply restricted to pharmacy-prepared 1 mg/mL syringes only, effective for tonight's shift pending further review.
decisions.dispensing_concentration: 1 mg/mL only — pharmacy-prepared syringes, with all bedside stock of both 1 mg/mL and 2 mg/mL concentrations removed from automated dispensing cabinets during the temporary hold.
decisions.laboratory_monitoring: aPTT test every six hours as the approved replacement for anti-Xa monitoring, continuing until the anti-Xa analyzer is available for calibration on Friday at 17:00.
decisions.nurse_authorization: Charge-nurse sign-off required for each of the 18 nurses scheduled for tonight's shift who have not completed the new anticoagulant administration module, before they are permitted to administer the medication under this protocol.
decisions.electronic_alert: High-priority electronic medication-record alert deployed at 16:00 today, warning clinicians about concentration selection and requiring acknowledgment before the order can be released.

commitments.detail: Remove bedside stock of both concentrations from automated dispensing cabinets and supply only pharmacy-prepared 1 mg/mL syringes during the temporary hold.
Use aPTT testing every six hours as the approved replacement for anti-Xa monitoring until the analyzer is available Friday at 17:00.
Ensure each of the 18 nurses who have not completed the competency module receives charge-nurse sign-off before administering the medication tonight.
Deploy the high-priority concentration-selection alert at 16:00 today, requiring clinician acknowledgment before order release.
